profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! I am a Software Engineer who discovered coding after years of full-time care giving to my children. I got started on CodeCademy solving problems and learning new concepts which lit up my brain up in a way I didn't know I needed.

I jumped in with both feet, taught myself basics of JavaScript so I could qualify and join Nashville Software School's AWS Software Engineering Program for nine months. It's been an incredible journey and I'm looking forward to exploring the wide world of coding professionally. 

Thanks for stopping in. Feel free to have a look around!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Intensive full-time, nine month software development bootcamp focusing on Java software engineering using AWS technologies. The program culminates in a web based capstone project designed to emulate working on a real world team, using Agile values with the Scrum framework.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · Computer Science · GitHub · Git · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Gradle · Grep · Amazon CloudWatch · IntelliJ IDEA · Visual Studio · JSON · Docker · AWS Lambda · Java · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
positions.description: Skills: Etsy · Canva · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Illustrator

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.locationName: Park City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: I assisted in the production of the hit streaming series, Yellowstone. I performed various tasks such as locking down filming sites, taking orders for actors, transporting equipment to remote locations, managing the holding place for extras, and ensuring authenticity of scenes filmed. I also took count for lunch and timed the lunch hour.

positions.title: Swimming Program Coordinator
positions.description: Hired, trained and managed 60+ swim teachers and teaching assistants with a program that served many hundreds of young swimmers in the summer alone, as well as during the off season. Used Sportsman to manage classes, rosters, and other various registration tasks. Provided help fielding questions of all manner to the many parents and children our program supported.

positions.title: Front Desk Attendant
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: Informed and registered participants in an ever-changing line up of 100 or so classes of gymnastics, swimming lessons, fitness classes, and youth programs and certifications. Helped patrons manage their membership i.e. change membership type, register new patron and canceled memberships. Trained and accurately handled money balancing and closing out till. Kept up to date with the new policies and processes for various occasional products we sold i.e. team swim gear, and gymnastic swim gear.

positions.title: Swim Instructor
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: Taught children how to swim according to the American Red Cross curriculum. Calmed nerves, and made swimming a positive experience! Worked with parents for special accommodations for special needs children as well as those who needed extra assistance for other reasons.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Assisted residents living in on-campus housing. Focused on fostering friendships among residents as well as ensuring safety and standards of cleanliness. Received training to mediate in crucial conversations, in recognizing mental health warning signs and the protocol to address it, leadership and emergency procedures in the event of a major disaster. Qualified and presented at a national conference for Resident Assistants, placing in top five.

positions.title: Front Desk Attendant
positions.description: Performed intakes and checked-in existing clients in a professional environment. Assisted grad students connecting to clients, and accessing materials they need. Managed parking permission.

positions.title: Volunteer "Pink Lady"
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: Manned the front desk in the evenings by myself. Looked up patient's location while maintaining privacy regulations. Stocked nursing supplies, and delivered flowers. I also assisted in the Radiology department with various tasks.
